title: Stapled Peptides as Direct Inhibitors of Nrf2-sMAF Transcription Factors.
authors: Modi, Ramya; McKee, Nick; Zhang, Ning; Alwali, Amir; Nelson, Samantha; Lohar, Aditi; Ostafe, Raluca; Zhang, Donna D; Parkinson, Elizabeth I
one_liner_zh: 该文利用AlphaFold预测设计订书肽抑制Nrf2-sMAF转录因子异二聚化，虽聚焦蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，但涉及转录因子复合物结构建模与互作抑制，方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面研究。
abstract: Nuclear factor erythroid-related 2-factor 2 (Nrf2) is a transcription factor traditionally thought of as a cellular protector. However, in many cancers, Nrf2 is constitutively activated and correlated with therapeutic resistance. Nrf2 heterodimerizes with small musculoaponeurotic fibrosarcoma Maf (sMAF) transcription factors, allowing binding to the antioxidant responsive element (ARE) and induction of transcription of Nrf2 target genes. While transcription factors are historically challenging to target, stapled peptides have shown great promise for inhibiting these protein-protein interactions. Herein, we describe the first direct cell-permeable inhibitor of Nrf2/sMAF heterodimerization. N1S is a stapled peptide designed based on AlphaFold predictions of the interactions between Nrf2 and sMAF MafG. A cell-based reporter assay combined with in vitro biophysical assays demonstrates that N1S directly inhibits Nrf2/MafG heterodimerization. N1S treatment decreases the transcription of Nrf2-dependent genes and sensitizes Nrf2-dependent cancer cells to cisplatin. Overall, N1S is a promising lead for the sensitization of Nrf2-addicted cancers.
abstract_zh: 核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）是一种传统上被视为细胞保护者的转录因子。然而，在许多癌症中，Nrf2被组成性激活，并与治疗耐药性相关。Nrf2与小肌肉腱膜纤维肉瘤Maf（sMAF）转录因子形成异二聚体，从而能够结合抗氧化反应元件（ARE）并诱导Nrf2靶基因的转录。尽管转录因子历来难以靶向，但订书肽在抑制这些蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用方面显示出巨大潜力。在此，我们描述了首个直接细胞通透性的Nrf2/sMAF异二聚化抑制剂。N1S是一种基于AlphaFold对Nrf2与sMAF MafG之间相互作用的预测而设计的订书肽。基于细胞的报告基因检测结合体外生物物理检测表明，N1S直接抑制Nrf2/MafG异二聚化。N1S处理降低了Nrf2依赖性基因的转录，并使Nrf2依赖性癌细胞对顺铂敏感。总体而言，N1S是使Nrf2依赖性癌症增敏的有前景的先导化合物。
